ubuntu-dock@ubuntu.com.reason: Replaced by MacOSDock, which provides the floating macOS dock with spring magnification that Ubuntu Dock/Dash to Dock cannot. The extension stays installed so it can be re-enabled at any time; MacOSDock supplies the equivalent launch/switch/preview/autohide functionality. Because Ubuntu's session mode force-enables this extension, it is also listed in disabled-extensions; that blacklist is what actually prevents it from loading.

ding@rastersoft.com.reason: Desktop Icons NG provides the macOS-like desktop; its icons are themed by WhiteSur.

ubuntu-appindicators@ubuntu.com.reason: Legacy tray/AppIndicator support is required by Telegram, Steam and similar apps.

gsconnect@andyholmes.github.io.reason: User relies on KDE Connect integration; unrelated to theming.

tiling-assistant@ubuntu.com.reason: Preserves Ubuntu window tiling; macOS-style traffic lights remain functional.

snapd-search-provider@canonical.com.reason: Search provider; left at its original state.

web-search-provider@ubuntu.com.reason: Search provider; left at its original state.

user-theme@gnome-shell-extensions.gcampa.reason: Loads the TPCT GNOME Shell theme (top bar, menus, Quick Settings, notifications, OSD).

tpct-mac-shell@tpct.reason: Power-of-two-free global menu bar: focused app menus, Finder menus, Apple-inspired system menu, right-aligned clock.

blur-my-shell@aunetx.reason: Real backdrop blur for the menu bar and Control Center/popovers. Panel and popup blur are static-cached (static-blur=true) so idle GPU cost stays low; the dock uses its own Shell.BlurEffect.

macos-dock@vinnytherobot.github.io.source: bundled (MIT), patched spring physics and glass
macos-dock@vinnytherobot.github.io.reason: macOS-style floating dock with magnification, running indicators, click-to-minimize, bounce and autohide. Vendored so the spring integrator and dock blur sigma are deterministic.

rejected.reason: GNOME 50 metadata is present, but the extension did not render a dock in the isolated GNOME 50 nested shell during testing. MacOSDock rendered correctly, supports magnification and exposes a clean custom-CSS hook, so it was selected instead.
Its published metadata does not list GNOME 50 (shell_version_map stops at 49). Forcing metadata is forbidden.
X11-only; the session is Wayland. TPCT's extension supports GTK GMenuModel over D-Bus and dbusmenu for XWayland.
